scope: one bounded AE-auto, IR-off YUV analysis capture from the Lumia 950 XL iris camera

whole_frame_contrast_proposal.use: display-only; excluded from diagnostic enrollment and comparison

image_quality.result: The signal gate passed, but no face-derived eye ROI was found. The scene contrast heuristic is not iris localization.

interpretation: AE yielded more image signal than the 30 ms / ISO 100 baseline. The instrumented Camera2 result confirms sensitivity 4860 is outside the advertised [100, 800] range, while post-RAW sensitivity boost is 100% (the only advertised value), so digital boost does not explain the discrepancy. The open-source HAL result path copies CAM_INTF_META_SENSOR_SENSITIVITY directly to ANDROID_SENSOR_SENSITIVITY and reports ISP digital gain separately as post-RAW boost. This points to an upstream vendor sensor-sensitivity metadata or gain-scaling issue; it does not establish the actual analog gain. This capture is not calibrated matcher evidence.
limitations: One still frame only; no saved pixels.
Full-frame crop only; no nonzero crop was observed.
